research.title: Accelerating Diffusion-Limited Aggregation with CUDA
research.event: XXVII Symposium on High Performance Computing Systems
research.abs: We present a GPU-accelerated implementation of Diffusion-Limited Aggregation using CUDA, exploring parallelization strategies and memory optimizations to improve simulation performance.

research.title: Evaluating Distributed HPC Workloads Across Cloud and Local Clusters
research.event: International Conference on High Performance Computing
research.abs: This work investigates the impact of network latency and bandwidth on distributed HPC workloads combining local computing clusters with geographically distributed cloud resources.
